    (And
      (∀ (i : Fin (Refpoly.KS.Seed.N S)),
        And (Refpoly.IsLatticePoint (Refpoly.KS.Seed.vertices S i))
          (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Refpoly.polarDual P) (Refpoly.KS.Seed.vertices S i)))
      (And (Refpoly.IsIP ((convexHull.{0, 0} Real) (Set.range.{0, 1} (Refpoly.KS.Seed.vertices S))))
        (And
          (∀ (T : Finset.{0} (Fin (Refpoly.KS.Seed.N S))),
            Ne.{1} T Finset.univ.{0} →
              Not (Refpoly.IsIP ((convexHull.{0, 0} Real) (Set.image.{0, 0} (Refpoly.KS.Seed.vertices S) ↑T))))
          (And (LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} d 1) (Refpoly.KS.Seed.N S))
            (LE.le.{0} (Refpoly.KS.Seed.N S) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 d))))))
